name: Apply Wall Finish (Spray + Backroll)
intent: Spray the wall field, then immediately backroll the wet film to work the paint into texture and even the laydown. NC production standard. One coat per module invocation. Scenarios needing two coats list this module twice with interstage between if QT4+. Cut-in to trim is handled by the standalone MOD_APPLY_CUTIN_TRIM module which fires in parallel (brush work, not part of the spray flow).
doctrine: Spray and backroll happen as a coordinated two-person flow: the sprayer leads, the backroller follows within 30 seconds while the film is still wet. Coat 2 is faster than coat 1 (coat_2_rate_multiplier: 1.08) because the sprayer can move quicker over an already-uniform surface. Complexity modifier applies — tight rooms slow the spray pattern. Per-task texture sensitivity is author-set via the Modifier Editor UI — typical config is spray texture-insensitive, backroll texture-sensitive; exceptions (popcorn, heavy stomp) warrant flipping spray back on.
